Each child entry contains `{node, file, selector}` for one immediate outline child in source order. When the language defines a declaration header for the child, its entry also includes `header`, the text of that span under {cite}`requirements.sdk.outlines.source_spans` with credential redaction. A leaf has an empty child list. Render the selected item's own source under {cite}`requirements.sdk.outlines.node_contents`. rationale:
The reviewed tests cover each obligation in `requirements.sdk.graph.validation-context.read_node.source_children`.

- **Page fields.** `mod[tests]/fn[agent_node_addresses_round_trip_and_reject_inconsistent_identities_before_reads]` in `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/project_sources.rs` asserts the whole parent page for `impl[Parser]`. That page has `file`, `selector`, `text` and `children`, and each child entry has `node`, `file`, `selector` and `header`. The test repeats the read by path, by node ID, by data, and from the `list_sources` entry. The root-file page is also asserted, and its only child is `impl[Parser]`. The nested `fn[parse]` does not appear there, so children are immediate only.
- **Child order.** `outline_continuations_keep_the_file_and_complete_ordered_items` reads a 400-function file. It checks that the children collected over paged reads equal the outline items in source order.
- **Header present.** The first test asserts `header` values `fn parse(&self) -> bool {` and `impl Parser {`.
- **Header redacted.** `child_headers_use_redacted_source_when_the_language_supplies_a_header` puts a GitHub token in a function header. It asserts the header reads `fn run(/* [REDACTED:GitHub Token] */) {` and that the token appears nowhere in the output.
- **Header absent.** The same test asserts that `struct[Marker]` has no `header` key. This is the case where the language supplies no header.
- **Leaf.** The first test asserts `children == []` for `fn[parse]`.
- **Own source.** The first test asserts the parent text is `impl Parser { … }`, with descendant source omitted, and the leaf text is the full function. The continuation test asserts that a root's text is paged and reassembled exactly. The own-source rendering rules belong to the cited `requirements.sdk.outlines.node_contents`, which is context and not reassessed here.
- **Dependencies.** The first test asserts the parent read's dependencies equal exactly `[expected("impl[Parser]")]`. Listing the child therefore adds no dependency on the child or on the set of children. Reading the child records exactly its own fingerprint, `expected("impl[Parser]/fn[parse]")`, by both path and ID. The continuation test asserts one dependency per root read, and its `read_nodes` log is `["code.rs#", "code.rs#fn[item_4]"]`.

I found no unexercised obligation and no marking gap.

text: :::{req} read_node.source_children

For a source node, `read_node` includes the project-relative `file`, its `selector`, and `children` in the result. Each child entry contains `{node, file, selector}` for one immediate outline child in source order. When the language defines a declaration header for the child, its entry also includes `header`, the text of that span under {cite}`requirements.sdk.outlines.source_spans` with credential redaction. A leaf has an empty child list. Render the selected item's own source under {cite}`requirements.sdk.outlines.node_contents`. Listing a child records no dependency on its contents or on the set of children. Reading that child records its own fingerprint.
:::{req} source_spans
`source_span` returns the original text at a file-relative `Span`, including when
called on a selected item. `source_span_redacted` accepts the same coordinates
and applies {cite}`requirements.sdk.sources.redaction` using the whole snapshot.
A span containing the first byte of a recognized credential receives its marker.
Each span preserves the line breaks in its portion of the credential. Joining
adjacent redacted spans produces the redacted text of their union.
Both methods return `None` for reversed bounds, out-of-file offsets, or offsets
inside a UTF-8 character. An empty span at a valid boundary returns empty text.
:::{req} node_contents
`trust_but_verify::outline::OutlineContent` implements
`trust_but_verify::domain::NodeContents`, making it usable directly as
`Domain::NodeContent` under
{cite}`requirements.sdk.graph.node_content`.

Its `fingerprint()` identifies the selected item's own outline-relevant contents under {cite}`requirements.sdk.graph.node_content.fingerprint`. Apply the language's fingerprinting rules to the item's own source, excluding its outline descendants and their attached source. Adding, removing, or editing a child alone preserves the parent's read fingerprint. A digest supplied through `with_own_hash` uses the language's structural scheme with the suffix `:own-v1` for read evidence.
Its `format()` renders the item's own source, omitting descendant source and redacting recognized credentials under {cite}`requirements.sdk.sources.redaction` and
{cite}`requirements.sdk.graph.node_content.format`.
Both operations describe the source snapshot retained by the value.
`text()` retains the original selected bytes for source inspection.
